semantics: Owner product decision 2026-10-31: merge by default when scientific names match. A national source usage (NorTaxa, Dyntaxa) whose canonical scientific name and rank equal exactly one live concept within Fungi is associated with that concept, preferring the COL-backed concept. Authorship, family, source identifiers and classification may differ. An association never allocates, retires or renumbers a Sporely id: an associated NorTaxa concept keeps its own live id, and the association is recorded per release in taxon_association_min so a later release can drop it. Associated usages' names, vernaculars, source ids and Red List rows are projected onto the primary concept.

rules.exact_accepted_name: The usage's accepted name and rank equal exactly one candidate primary concept.
rules.unique_synonym_bridge: No candidate has the usage's accepted name; exactly one candidate's accepted name is a synonym of this usage and of no other accepted usage in the same source, and no other usage of that source is associated with the candidate.

blocking_reasons.qualified_concept: The name, authorship or concept annotation qualifies the concept (coll., s.lat., s.str., agg., sensu, auct., pro parte, cf., aff.).
blocking_reasons.source_homonym: Two accepted usages of the same source share the name and rank.
blocking_reasons.multiple_primary_candidates: More than one live concept is a candidate.
blocking_reasons.primary_claimed_by_other_usage: Another usage of the same source already maps to the candidate.
blocking_reasons.already_bridged: The usage already has an authoritative bridge in the base release; it is kept as is.
blocking_reasons.continuity_hold: The usage is under an owner hold in source_continuity_holds.json.
blocking_reasons.reviewed_exclusion: The association is listed in exclusions below.
